content.summary: Review of Provider Quota Widget: NEEDS WORK - Widget not using cache

findings.issue: Helper functions (isRecord, stringFrom, numberFrom, etc.) are well-designed for defensive parsing
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting to a shared utility if reused elsewhere

findings.issue: Reference equality check `data === entry.data` will always be false for fresh fetches since objects are different instances
findings.suggestion: This check is unnecessary but harmless - could be removed for clarity

code.summary: Code quality is good. Follows project conventions (no let, no try/catch, const with early returns). Type-safe and passes typecheck.

security.summary: No security issues found. Auth tokens handled correctly via Authorization headers. No sensitive data in logs. URLs are hardcoded (no injection risk).

findings.issue: Inline IIFE with imperative logic inside declarative JSX. Logic for formatting names, currencies, and deciding what text to show is braided with the rendering structure.
findings.suggestion: Extract to a pure functional component (e.g., `<QuotaDisplay info={quota()} providerName={...} />`) to separate the 'how' of formatting from the 'what' of the UI tree.

findings.issue: Module-level mutable singleton `cache` creates implicit shared state.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for MVP TUI widget - would need refactoring for testability at scale.

findings.issue: Provider-specific business logic is complected with HTTP fetching.
findings.suggestion: Consider QuotaProvider interface to separate implementations from caching layer in future.

simplicity.summary: Implementation works but has typical braids. UI mixes formatting with structure, data layer mixes fetching/parsing/caching. Acceptable for MVP but noted for future cleanup.

findings.issue: Widget uses `ProviderQuota.fetch()` instead of `ProviderQuota.fetchCached()`. The cache implementation exists but is NOT being used, causing fresh API calls on every provider/message change.

requirements.summary: The cache feature (quota-cache.md work item) is implemented in the service but NOT integrated into the widget. This defeats the purpose of the 60s TTL caching requirement.

blocking_issues.issue: Widget not using fetchCached - cache implementation is unused

suggestions.issue: IIFE in JSX could be extracted to component
Add error case tests for Anthropic/OpenRouter fetchers
suggestions.impact: Improves test coverage but core functionality tested
